description: Get keywords related to a word or phrase, each with its relation: similar_meaning and found_with (words often used with it) from the Datamuse API (English), and completion (Wikipedia titles that extend the phrase, in the lang Wikipedia). No search volume is given. Costs 1 credit. Every row has name (platform/collection/id), kind, its fields and source {platform, url, license, attribution, fetched_at, terms_url}; quote source.attribution when you show a row.

lang.description: Optional Wikipedia language code (default en; Datamuse answers only in en).

q.description: The word or phrase, such as "electric car".

name: data_related_keywords
title: Find keywords related to a topic
